userLogNoteText:
Sable had a digifin leak abort. 
After reviewing data, seems like its a classic surface fin issue. 
Ran two 150m dives, ran fine no signs of leak. 
- set back to run 3 full yo's. 
-set threshold for leak abort to 10 (5 by default)
Next surfacing we will switch to 22 deg dive/climb
Sable is running two segments of 3 full yos to 340m (up to 30m) diving at 26 deg.

200m dive was successful. 
When surfaced, sent s*.scd *.tcd *.asc, it started sending off ecd & dcd for some reason. 

Zcancelled those.  Then when I sent new mission files it tripped on them, then aborted for beh error after. Resent and restarted mission

Sable was deployed at 1237 by Zach & Noa. 
Passed its initial testing and has been stepped down to a single 200m yo
